career_entries_date_pairs.name: career_entries_date_pairs
career_entries_date_pairs.value:
("career_entries"."start_date" IS NULL) = ("career_entries"."start_date_precision" IS NULL)
          AND ("career_entries"."end_date" IS NULL) = ("career_entries"."end_date_precision" IS NULL)

career_entries_date_order.name: career_entries_date_order
career_entries_date_order.value: "career_entries"."end_date" IS NULL OR "career_entries"."start_date" IS NULL OR "career_entries"."end_date" >= "career_entries"."start_date"
